about: Rastakhan's Rumble's interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): the troll arena of Zuldazar on fight night — dark panels of jungle-shadowed stone with gold rims like the ziggurats' gilded steps, buttons of deep jungle teal that flare gold under the mouse like a champion's armour in the sun, warm sun-bleached parchment text, gold for headings, blood red for danger and the ghostly teal of the Loa spirits for confirmations, sparks drifting up from the arena braziers over the menu; the title in Classic's Cinzel Decorative, in gold.
